title: Improving Semantic Understanding in Speech Language Models via Brain-tuning

layout.note: Panel (a) spans the full width on top as a left-to-right network strip; below it, panel (b) fills the left half (two input branches into an alignment estimate, split by a dashed divider) and panel (c) the right half (a ruled two-row by three-column outcome table with colour scales above and Better arrows below).

lesson: Pair the training network with an expected-outcome table that has the same model icon as row heads, colour-scale column heads and up or down Better arrows, so the hypothesis is drawn before any result. Snowflake and flame icons with Freeze and Fine-tune captions state the trained parts at a glance.
